title: Pothole Patrol
tagline: Turns smartphones into AI-powered dashcams to crowdsource a map of road infrastructure.
description: Pothole Patrol is a DePIN and DeSci initiative that democratizes infrastructure monitoring. By combining privacy-first Edge AI (YOLOv8 via WASM) with World ID's Proof of Personhood, we enable citizens to collect road damage data - such as Potholes! All reports are permanently anchored on Filecoin, creating the world's first open, trustless Knowledge Graph for urban maintenance.
how_its_made: A Next.js-based DePIN application utilizing client-side WASM for real-time YOLOv8 inference to detect potholes. It features a 'Sense-Verify-Anchor' architecture: local detection for privacy, World ID MiniKit for Sybil-resistant batch verification, and Lighthouse SDK for immutable storage on Filecoin, exporting data as a Schema.org-compliant JSON-LD Knowledge Graph.
